events.title: Rooftop engagement party
events.notes: Celia + Marcus — rooftop at 1 Hotel Brooklyn Bridge. Band plus late dinner. Heels on grass not ideal; bring a wrap for the river breeze.

events.title: Cecilie Bahnsen resort preview
events.notes: Intimate press preview of the Resort 2026 collection. Camera at the door; Vogue Runway will be shooting. No obvious logos.

events.title: Weekend in Hudson
events.notes: Dinner at Talbott & Arding Saturday. Farmers market and Olana walk Sunday. Need something that travels flat in a small duffel.

events.title: Monday editorial shoot
events.notes: Cover test for a spring fashion issue. Arrive in something the stylist can photograph on the way in — they love a BTS 'arrivals' look.
